resolutions.researcher_notes: Original ref (almasryalyoum.com/news/details/103848) was in the brief's DEAD_LINK class but is now live again (200, Arabic content present) — however it covers only the Dec-2010 Aswan-segment opening ceremony, not this Beni Suef-Abu Qurqas stage, so it wasn't used for this cell. Instead used two independent trade-press pieces that describe the pipeline's construction in five discrete stages: The Australian Pipeliner (2009-09-23, Petrojet/NVGC project update) states 'Stage two involved the construction of 150 km of pipeline extending from Beni Suef to Abu Qurqas' — described in the PAST tense as already complete, distinct from 'The final stage involves...anticipated to be completed by 2010' (i.e. stage 2/this segment was operating well before the 2010 full-line inauguration). Petroleum Africa (2011-01-03, post-inauguration wrap-up) corroborates: 'stage two extends 150 km from Beni Suef to Abu Qurqas' as part of a pipeline it describes as fully 'commissioned in late November [2010]' with a stated current throughput capacity (8 bcm/yr, rising to 12 bcm/yr by 2014) — status is inferred from operational/throughput context per confidence_tiers.md, not a literal 'operating' string match. Two independent trade outlets (Australian Pipeliner Association's magazine vs. an Africa-energy trade site), neither tracing to GEM or to each other. No contradiction found — both agree on stage sequencing and dating.

Both sources give the exact figure verbatim. Australian Pipeliner (2009): 'Stage two involved the construction of 150 km of pipeline extending from Beni Suef to Abu Qurqas.' Petroleum Africa (2011): 'stage two extends 150 km from Beni Suef to Abu Qurqas.' Two independent outlets, same figure, no conflict — matches GEM's LengthKnown=150.00 km exactly. Neither source states pipe diameter for this specific stage (diameters are given only for stages 3-5), so LengthKnownUnits/LengthKnown is fully supported but no diameter corroboration was attempted here (out of scope for this unit).

Both sources confirm endpoints 'Beni Suef' (start) and 'Abu Qurqas' (end) for this stage, matching StartLocation/EndLocation. StartState/Province=Beni Suef is confirmed directly (both sources name the town/governorate). EndState/Province=Minya is corroborated indirectly but consistently in both: each source describes the NEXT stage (stage three) as running 'from the governorate of Minya to Assiut' immediately following the Beni Suef-Abu Qurqas segment, i.e. Abu Qurqas sits at/near the Minya governorate boundary where stage three picks up — consistent with Abu Qurqas being a Minya Governorate town (general geographic fact, not disputed by any source found). StartCountryOrArea/EndCountryOrArea=Egypt is self-evident from both articles' subject matter. No contradiction found.
